title: Abel and Yeshua were hated by their brothers
summary: Genesis 4:8 (Cain rose up against his brother Abel and killed him) and John 15:25 ("They hated Me without a cause") frame the conclusion that Abel and Yeshua (Jesus) were both hated by their brothers.

text.text: 8 And Cain talked with Abel his brother; and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother and killed him.
Abel & yeshua were hated by their brothers
25 But this happened that the word might be fulfilled which is written in their law, ‘They hated Me without a cause.’

themes: Abel as a type of Christ
